verses.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਗੋ ਬੰਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਰਨ ਦੁਹੇ ਦੂਧ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: baran baran bahu baran go ba(n)s jaise ek hee baran dhuhe dhoodh jag jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as the cows are of many breeds and colours, yet the whole world knows that they all yield milk of the same colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਕੈ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਏਕੈ ਰੂਪ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: anik prakaar fal fool kai banaasapatee ekai roop agan sarab mai samaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: There are many species of fruit and flower trees but all carry the same latent fire in them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਪਾਨ ਚੂਨਾ ਅਉ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਾਥਾ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਮਿਲਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਠਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: chatur baran paan choonaa aau supaaree kaathaa aapaa khoi milat anoop roop Thaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Four different colours-beetle leaf, Supari (beetle nut), Kattha (extract of the bark of accacia) and lime shed their own colour and merge in each other in a Paan and make beautiful red colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੯॥
verses.translit_en: logan mai logaachaar gurmukh eka(n)kaar sabadh surat unaman unamaaneeaai ||39||

en.bdb: Similarly the Guru-conscious person (Gurmukh) renounces various worldly pleasures and adopts one colour of the formless God. And because of the blessings of his Guru who has taught him to unite with the divine word and his mind, he achieves higher spiritual state. (39)
